title: Wolof-Adapted Industry-Ready Open-Weight Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.20824v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Wolof is spoken by 23M people, mostly in Senegal, but remains weakly supported by open-weight language models, while API models raise cost, governance, and sovereignty constraints for local deployments. In this paper, we present 0.6B-14B open-weight models adapted to Wolof through instruction tuning, preference alignment, and model merging. After presenting the pipeline and data, extensive experiments on 63~public and in-house tasks show good performance on Wolof understanding and generation while remaining effective on other languages and cross-lingual skills, with the 8B and 14B models being particularly competitive with substantially larger commercial systems. The models are currently being evaluated in internal customer-care pilots and are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/collections/Orange/wolof-lm .

translated_title: 沃洛夫语适配的工业级开放权重语言模型
translated_abstract: 沃洛夫语有2300万使用者，主要分布在塞内加尔，但开放权重语言模型对该语言的支持仍然薄弱，而API模型在本地部署中会带来成本、治理和主权方面的限制。在本文中，我们通过指令微调、偏好对齐和模型合并技术，提出了适配沃洛夫语的0.6B-14B开放权重模型。在介绍完技术流程和数据后，我们在63个公开和内部任务上进行了大量实验，结果显示这些模型在沃洛夫语理解和生成方面表现良好，同时在其他语言和跨语言技能上也保持有效，其中8B和14B模型尤其具有竞争力，可与规模大得多的商业系统相媲美。这些模型目前正在内部客户服务试点中进行评估，并已在https://huggingface.co/collections/Orange/wolof-lm公开发布。
tldr: 本文通过指令微调、偏好对齐和模型合并构建了0.6B-14B的沃洛夫语适配开放权重模型，在63项任务上表现出色，其中8B和14B模型可与更大的商业系统相竞争，且已公开发布。
en_tdlr: This paper presents 0.6B-14B open-weight language models adapted to Wolof through instruction tuning, preference alignment, and model merging, showing strong performance across 63 tasks, with the 8B and 14B models competitive against substantially larger commercial systems and publicly released.
